title: 第7章 叫人第8章 倒霉的陈广灵
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 南云起脸色煞白，他急忙硬着头皮朝院外跑去。
“乔儿，你快点找地方躲起来，别待会被天宝阁的人伤到！”杨红梅急忙对南乔说道。
“哼，那个废物干的好事自然是由他来承担，我去找他！”南乔说完朝后外走去。
“对对，赶紧去东院把那个废物抓来！”杨红梅迅速点头。
此时，南家两名长老，以及所有的家族核心成员全都赶了过来。
当他们知道打陈少杰的人是秦关后，全都怒不可遏，这个废物竟然给南家惹了这么大的祸。
“陈阁主，您是不是误会了，我这女婿就是一个弱的不能再弱的小武夫，他非但打不过，也不可能有那个胆子敢打少主啊！”南云起急忙上前解释道。
“还敢狡辩，此事老夫已经证据确凿，今天你们南家若是不给老夫一个满意的结果，天宝阁绝饶不了南家！”
陈广灵直接指着南云起的鼻子骂道。
陈广灵刚骂完，脸肿的像个猪头的陈少杰马上又骂：
“你个老兔崽子，少踏马的废话，赶紧把那个小畜生给本少交出来，否则今晚你们南家不保！”
南云起连着被人指着头骂，袖袍中攥紧的手指差点扣进掌肉里。
这时，杨红梅急忙上前满脸的陪笑道：
“陈阁主，小杰少主，你们放心，真要是秦关那个废物打了你，我们南家绝对不会偏袒他，任由你们处置！”
听到杨红梅的话，陈少杰点头：“秦关那个小畜生非死不可，不过那个南柔姑娘…”
想到南柔那张绝美的脸蛋，陈少杰的口水差点从没牙的嘴里流出来。
早就听闻这个陈少杰好色无度，不是玩女人就是在玩女人的路上，杨红梅哪能不知，于是急忙笑道：“少主放心，柔儿也任凭您处置。”
“滚下去！”杨红梅刚说完，南云起突然朝她怒喝。
“你疯啦！”杨红梅吓了一跳，这南云起还从来没敢这样吼过她。
“老夫是南家之主，这里还轮不到你来做主！”南云起狠狠地瞪了一眼杨红梅。
杨红梅气的一跺脚，指着南云起骂道：
“好你个南云起，朝我娘家要资源的时候你忘了你那低声下气的样子了？你跟我吼，这些年要不是我们杨家扶持你，你能做上南家家主？”
被杨红梅那尖锐的骂声刺的耳朵疼，陈少杰气的不耐烦：
“够了！老子可不是来看你们两个老东西吵架的，赶紧把秦关那个小畜生还有南柔给本少交出来，不然的话就踏平你们南家！”
“啧啧，踏平南家，牙都没了还敢说大话！”
就在这时，秦关慢悠悠的走了过来。
南柔则是紧紧拉着秦关的衣角跟在他身边，刚才听到妹妹说对方带着几十号人找上门来，她吓得差点晕过去，她想让秦关逃跑，结果被南乔给阻止了。
“小畜生你…”
陈少杰看到秦关刚要骂，可当他目光注意到南柔与南乔时，眼神顿时一亮。
陈少杰捂了捂笑的生疼的嘴巴：“哎哟两个大美人！”
“少杰，你确定是他打的你？”陈广灵打量了一眼秦关狐疑道。
“就是这个小畜生，他是个武夫，偷袭了我，要不然我打死他！”陈少杰目光阴狠道。
“原来是个没前途的武夫。”陈广灵冷哼一声，接着他手一挥：“拿下！”
几名护卫正要动手，南云起突然沉声道：
“陈阁主，我们南家虽然只是一个三流家族，但你们这样闯进来抓人未免太仗势欺人了吧？”
“仗势欺人？”
陈广灵眸光一冷：“你女婿把我儿打成这样，老夫没把你南家踏平就已经很仁慈了，你跟老夫说仗势欺人？”
content_en:
Nan Yunqi's face turned pale, and he hurriedly ran out of the hospital.
"Qiao'er, hurry up and find a place to hide. Don't get hurt by the people from Tianbao Pavilion later!" Yang Hongmei said hurriedly to Nan Qiao.
"Hmph, of course he will be responsible for the good deeds done by that good-for-nothing. I'll go find him!" After Nan Qiao finished speaking, he walked towards the back.
"That's right, hurry up and catch that trash in the east courtyard!" Yang Hongmei nodded quickly.
At this time, the two elders of the Nan family and all the core members of the family rushed over.
When they found out that the person who beat Chen Shaojie was Qin Guan, they were all furious. This good-for-nothing had caused so much trouble to the Nan family.
"Pavilion Master Chen, have you misunderstood? My son-in-law is an extremely weak little martial artist. Not only can he not be able to defeat him, he also cannot have the courage to defeat the young master!" Nan Yunqi hurriedly stepped forward to explain.
"You still dare to quibble. I have solid evidence on this matter. If your Nan family doesn't give me a satisfactory result today, Tianbao Pavilion will never spare the Nan family!"
Chen Guangling pointed directly at Nan Yunqi's nose and cursed.
As soon as Chen Guangling finished scolding, Chen Shaojie, whose face was swollen like a pig's head, immediately scolded again:
"You old bastard, stop talking nonsense and hand over that little beast to me as soon as possible, otherwise your Nan family will not be safe tonight!"
Nan Yunqi was pointed at his head and scolded continuously, and the fingers clenched tightly in his sleeves almost dug into the flesh of his palms.
At this time, Yang Hongmei hurriedly stepped forward and said with a smile on her face:
"Pavilion Master Chen, Young Master Xiaojie, don't worry, if that good-for-nothing Qin Guan really beats you, our Nan family will never favor him and let you do whatever you want!"
Hearing Yang Hongmei's words, Chen Shaojie nodded: "That little beast Qinguan must die, but that girl Nanrou..."
Thinking of Nanrou's beautiful face, Chen Shaojie's saliva almost flowed out of Toothless's mouth.
She had long heard that Chen Shaojie was lustful and either playing with women or on the road to playing with women. How could Yang Hongmei not know this, so she hurriedly smiled and said: "Don't worry, young master, Rou'er is at your disposal."
"Get out!" As soon as Yang Hongmei finished speaking, Nan Yunqi suddenly shouted angrily at her.
"You're crazy!" Yang Hongmei was startled. Nan Yunqi had never dared to yell at her like this before.
"I am the head of the Nan family, it is not your turn to make the decision here!" Nan Yunqi glared at Yang Hongmei fiercely.
Yang Hongmei stamped her foot angrily, pointed at Nan Yunqi and cursed:
"Hey Nan Yunqi, did you forget how groveling you were when you asked for resources from my natal family? You yelled at me, if our Yang family hadn't supported you all these years, would you have been able to become the head of the Nan family?"
His ears hurt from Yang Hongmei's sharp scolding, and Chen Shaojie became impatient:
"That's enough! I'm not here to see you two old guys quarreling. Hand over that little beast Qinguan and Nanrou to me quickly, otherwise I will crush your Nan family!"
"Tsk, tsk, you have defeated the Nan family, and you still have the guts to talk nonsense even if you don't have any teeth!"
At this moment, Qin Guan walked over slowly.
Nan Rou held Qing Guan's clothes tightly and followed him. She was so frightened that she almost fainted when she heard her sister say that the other party came to the door with dozens of people. She wanted Qing Guan to escape, but was stopped by Nan Qiao.
"You little beast..."
Chen Shaojie saw Qin Guangang and was about to scold him, but when he noticed Nan Rou and Nan Qiao, his eyes suddenly lit up.
Chen Shaojie covered his sore mouth from laughing: "Oh, two beauties!"
"Shaojie, are you sure he hit you?" Chen Guangling looked at Qin Guan and asked suspiciously.
"It's this little beast. He's a martial artist. He attacked me secretly, or I'll beat him to death!" Chen Shaojie said with a sinister look.
"It turns out he is a martial artist with no future." Chen Guangling snorted coldly, then waved his hand: "Take it down!"
Several guards were about to take action when Nan Yunqi suddenly said in a deep voice:
"Pavilion Master Chen, although our Nan family is only a third-rate family, it's too much of a bully for you to break in and arrest people like this, isn't it?"
"Bullying others with power?"
Chen Guangling's eyes turned cold: "Your son-in-law beat my son like this. I was already very merciful without destroying your Nan family. Are you telling me to use your power to bully others?"
title_en: Chapter 7: Calling for help Chapter 8: Unlucky Chen Guangling
